summary: During an approach to Cali at night, navigation errors and loss of situational awareness preceded a collision with mountainous terrain. Four of 163 aboard survived.
finding: The investigation identified navigation and crew-resource-management failures.

summary: An uncontained turbine failure damaged aircraft systems; the crew returned safely to Singapore.
finding: ATSB identified a fatigue crack in a nonconforming oil-feed stub pipe.

summary: A bird encounter resulted in near-total thrust loss in both engines. All 155 aboard survived the Hudson River ditching.
finding: NTSB determined that large birds were ingested into both engines.
